newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly lower in OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly lower in OTC trade.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter market in Varazdin, including its Osijek outpost, for Thursday, October 24.
* Of 13 active issues eight were down, two up and three remained flat.
* Volume lower at 2,171 shares, turnover also down at 145,537 German marks.
* 10-stock VIN index fell 6.24 percent to 8,753 points.
* The biggest loser was hotelier Suncani Hvar which fell 26.09 percent, closing at 17 marks.
* Top gainer was another tourist company -- Hoteli Imperial Rabac -- which jumped from 24.5 to 40 marks, or 63.27 percent, on meagre volume of 30 shares.
* The most actively traded issue was Istrian hotelier Jadranturist with 915 shares traded, closing down at 75 marks, 25 percent down from Wedensday.
